bodyDescription: A tasty treat for your dog consisting of beef rawhide and chicken. These chew sticks are delicious, provide chewing pleasure and therefore contributeto healthy teeth. In addition, this snack is rich in animal protein. Their size makes them particularly suitable for larger breeds.
